scope: Only M64 QKV; all incumbent selectors, gate/up, O, down, LM and other shapes remain authoritative
wrapper_specification: An isolated SkinnyMatmul subclass sets BLOCK_M=64, block_n=32, block_k=64, split_k=1, num_warps=4, num_stages=3, persist=0. Preserve existing kernel bytes. Surround with original add_rms_norm for the complete QKV call.
pointer_contract: All BF16 CUDA tensors contiguous and base addresses divisible by 16; a=[64,2560], w=[6144,2560], c=[64,6144]; c cannot share storage with inputs. Complete-call residual output is separately allocated and written only by add_rms_norm.
minimal_compile_plan: Freeze the unchanged kernel and proposed wrapper, hash all inputs, and parse only; do not import the full model.

Use pinned Triton3.1.0 native binder and specialization configuration with actual BF16 pointer dtypes/alignment and the exact runtime values above. Preserve actual signature, constexprs, divisibility/equal-to-one attributes, parsed backend options and native key. Do not copy old attributes or fabricate constexpr strides.

Authorize at most one sequential CPU-only sm90 build with CUDA12.4/PTXAS, no driver context or GPU execution. Bound the single build to40s and total worker to90s. No retries or sweep; stop on native-key/preflight mismatch or compiler failure.
Save TTIR/TTGIR/LLVM/PTX/cubins, compiler diagnostics, native records, register/shared/stack/spill metadata and hashes.

Independently verify m64n32k16 BF16/FP32 WGMMA with one four-warp group, 16-byte contiguous K copies, three operand stages and correctly drained copy/dot work, contiguous unique N ownership, forty K64 steps, one BF16 output cast, and no partial buffer accesses, local memory, stack or spills. Reject unexpected lowering or resource regressions rather than broadening the search.
later_measurement_condition: Compiler validation alone never authorizes a performance conclusion. If root later chooses integration, place this optional comparison after existing N32 selection so it cannot steal incumbent selection budget; preserve budget reserve, owned asynchronous buffers and fatal failed-drain behavior. Compare all36 complete add_norm+QKV calls with original weights/norms, exact residual equality, finite pointwise BF16 error, both timing orders and >3% margin. Maintain one official test at a time.
